method: Replica run over the 99 selected /en/ pages: every host-bound or vendor-bound feature ships its captured settled state as a static snapshot (finders, counters, listings), the request form is rebuilt natively with submission disabled, consent manager / tags / Maps key are owner decisions and load nothing on the new host; checks replay flows that exist on the interim tier and prove that no vendor or source-origin request leaks.

features.owner: Configure a CCM19 property for the new host (which modal, which services); the footer Settings link then opens it.

checks.selector: footer a[href*='#'], footer a[href*='ccm'], footer .footer a

features.feature: Tag manager and analytics (GTM, GA/Ads, etracker, session replay, LinkedIn, Bing)
features.owner: Decide which tags run on the new host; property ids remain the owner's. Until then no tag loads.

features.verifiedBy: read only at detect time: keys named the endpoints and vendors; nothing shipped

features.feature: Request / contact form (per-page field sets) posting to /mwf_live/servlet/rest
features.owner: Route /mwf_live/servlet/rest same-origin on production or name the production endpoint; until then submission is disabled and the authored notice is shown.

.mwf-form form input, .mwf-form form select, .mwf-form form textarea

features.owner: Add the search results page to scope; then index-backed search over /query-index.json.

Approve a dealer-data snapshot under data/location-finder/ (or same-origin routing of the source JSON) to make the finder searchable.

features.owner: Add the new host to the Maps browser key's referrer allow-list; the map box is static until then.
Locale scope for later waves; alternates keep pointing at the source origin.
